text: # GEO report: brightside-dental **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 73/100, Good Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 18.25 ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. High = (18.25 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. Everything was decidable from the code. The site is a small Eleventy static site, so the content is in the HTML. The main problems are a canonical tag (the tag that names a page's official address) that points at a staging domain, a missing `lang`, invalid structured data, and one page that is hidden from search but still listed in the sitemap. These results are read from code. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Point the canonical at the real domain - **Why it matters:** Every page tells search engines its official address is on `staging.`, not your `www.` domain. That can send them to the wrong site. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small. Use `https://www.brightside-dental.example`, which is `site.origin` in `geo.config.json`. - **Score after this:** 81/100 ### 2. Add `lang` and the missing team description - **Why it matters:** Without `lang`, tools can't tell what language the pages are in. The Team page has no description, so search results show arbitrary text for it. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:2` and `src/team.njk:1-4` - **What the code says:** `` and a front matter with `title: Meet the team` and no `description` - **Size:** Small. Use `` and add a `description` to the team page. - **Score after this:** 81/100 ### 3. Fix the invalid JSON-LD - **Why it matters:** JSON-LD is structured data that labels facts for machines. This block has a trailing comma, so it is invalid JSON and gets ignored. - **Where:** `src/contact.njk:10` - **What the code says:** `"telephone": "0113 496 0000", }` - **Size:** Small. Remove the comma. - **Score after this:** 81/100 Doing all three, plus the Services fix below, would give 100/100. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt valid | Clear | `src/robots.txt` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Clear | `src/robots.txt:1-2` (assumed from the `allow` policy in `geo.config.json`) | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Problem | `src/services.njk:5` `noindex: true`. 1 of 4 routes affected (3 of 4 clear) | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own origin | Problem | `src/_includes/base.njk:8`. All routes | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Clear | Eleventy static build | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Problem | `src/contact.njk:10` | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Clear | `src/sitemap.xml`, `src/robots.txt:3` | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | `src/_includes/base.njk:2`. `lang` is missing everywhere; Team also has no description | | GEO-016 | Routes linked in HTML | Clear | `src/_includes/base.njk:12` | | GEO-017 | No page-wide snippet blocks | Clear | Only `data-nosnippet` at `src/contact.njk:8`, which is a deliberate choice | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Read the layout and the home page. The image has `alt` and the links have text | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | Not an app | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | Not present; not scored | ## Other problems found - **Services is hidden but advertised:** `src/services.njk:5`: `noindex: true`. The page is in `src/sitemap.xml:4` and the main nav. Remove `noindex` if it should be found. This is the one hiding your main treatment list. - **Image likely missing:** `src/index.njk:8`: ``; add real dates. - **Organisation identity:** `src/_includes/base.njk:3-10`. There are no social tags (`og:title`, `og:description`) and no site-wide WebSite or Organization data. - **Emergency care:** `src/index.njk:7`: `Emergency appointments available.` Add a dedicated section or page with the out-of-hours number. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live status codes and headers:** redirects, 200 responses and any `X-Robots-Tag` header set at hosting can only be confirmed with a live scan. ## Assumptions - You want AI search tools to find this site. `geo.config.json` says `allow`. - The `www.brightside-dental.example` origin in `geo.config.json` is the real one and `staging.` is a mistake. - `thanks` is deliberately `noindex` and not linked, so I left it out of the route count. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-015`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
